title: Awesome experience!
text: It was absolutely wonderful! We learned so much from Fernando! He not only taught us how to make tapa, he explained each step and why it is done that! Now our standards are higher when tasting tapas! Thank you so much!! We truly enjoyed the experience and meeting the others in our small group!
author: Kathleen_C

title: Excellent

title: Book it. You won’t regret it.
text:
Fernando was awesome. Personable, fun and a great teacher.  The space was cool. Cooking during the day, after hours audio files listen to music on their headphones and have a silent dance party, and other days DJs are there to try out their mixes.  Back to cooking. My word the croquetas were so good. I couldn’t believe we made them. I could and probably did eat them to I was about to pop. The tortilla de paptas I will definitely try for a weekend breakfast. The sangria was delicious. And now I know why other Sangrias have given me a headache some time later. 

In short, 100% recommend  Fernand
author: Michael_F

title: Our chef was very...
text: Our chef was very knowledgeable and flexible given the small number of participants in two simultaneous classes. He combined both the Tapas class with the paella class enhancing the experience for both. The Cava, Sangria, both red and white, were excellent.
author: Doris_M

title: Perfect for NON  Paella lovers!
text:
Tim and Marta were incredible sweet, knowledgeable and made us feel at home. The place was immaculate too.
 The cooking class was Tapas only.  
Paella classes are everywhere and we really were looking for something more specific to the culture and cuisine. (We have done amazing Paella classes too!)
 Combined this was our 5th trip to Barcelona from America for my friend and I.
 Viva Spain🇪🇸💃🏼💕
author: Seaside52150989448

title: SO good!
text: This experience was amazing! The staff was so kind and helpful. The food was so good and it was great fun to put it all together! Highly recommend!
author: heather_m

title: Tapas cooking for the whole family
text: Great experience for our whole family! We made several different tapas and sangria while learning about the Catalan culture. It was the perfect way to spend a night! 10 out of 10 experience!
